=== CONVERSATION (human + agent) ===
[Agent] Got it — those degradation messages are awful. Looking at the code now to fix the tone and reduce the noise.
[Agent] test
[Agent] Fixed. Two changes to how degradation messages work for all instar agents:

1. Conversational tone — instead of the old technical format, agents will now say something like: "Heads up: quota data may be estimated rather than authoritative. Your agent is still running — this usually resolves on its own."

2. Deduplication — same degradation won't alert more than once per hour. No more getting spammed 4x with the same message.

Technical details stay in console logs for debugging — users just get the plain-English impact. Built, tested, ready for next publish.
[Agent] Done! Just sent the details to our main thread. Summary: conversational format + 1hr dedup cooldown per feature. All tests pass, clean build. Want me to bump the version and publish?
[Agent] Good question — let me check what the current logic is.
[Agent] Right now? Not at all. Every single degradation gets filed as a bug report to instar — no filtering, no intelligence. A rate limit that clears in 5 seconds gets the same treatment as a genuinely broken native binding.

The problems:
• No transient vs. persistent distinction — blips and real bugs look the same
• Dedup barely works since titles include raw error strings that vary slightly
• No cooldown on reporting, so the same feature can generate dozens of reports/hour
• Every agent running instar independently reports the same issues

What it should do: track occurrence counts per feature, only report to instar after sustained failure (3+ hits in 10 minutes = real bug, single hit = transient blip), and cooldown per feature so it only files once per 24hrs.

Want me to build that intelligence layer?

Respond in this EXACT JSON format (no other text):
{
  "summary": "2-3 sentence overview of what happened in this activity unit",
  "actions": ["key action 1", "key action 2"],
  "learnings": ["insight or lesson learned"],
  "significance": 5,
  "themes": ["topic1", "topic2"]
}

RULES:
- significance is 1-10 (1=trivial, 5=normal, 8+=major milestone)
- themes are 1-3 word topic tags
- actions are specific: "committed migration engine", not "wrote code"
- learnings are insights, not descriptions: "FTS5 requires sync triggers", not "worked on FTS5"
